value.title: The Split
value.synopsis: Six new couples arrive to test their relationships, but flirtations during speed dating and cocktail hour unleash jealousy on day one.

value.title: Seven Days of Temptation
value.synopsis: Money. Sex. Killer whales. No topic is off limits across a week of dates as the exes decide who they see a future with before making their choice.

value.title: The Choice
value.synopsis: Two participants send shockwaves through the choice ceremony. When the dust settles, the new couples move in together for three weeks of trial marriage.

value.title: One Door Closes, Another Bedroom Opens
value.synopsis: Two couples break the rules and clash face-to-face in a dramatic showdown as jealousy and betrayal dominate the start of their trial marriages.

value.title: He Said, She Said
value.synopsis: Drama runs amok when a contestant must answer for what they've said. Later, truths emerge at Guys Night, and the women take sides at Ladies Night.

value.title: Masterminds of Manipulation
value.synopsis: As the turbulent month wraps up with a volatile changeover ceremony, some couples are ready to return to normal while others aren't so sure.

value.title: The Changeover
value.synopsis: Building on the trial marriages, everyone brings new perspectives to their original partners. But clashing love languages threaten one couple's future.

value.title: Question Everything
value.synopsis: With only two weeks to go, the couples get a fresh look at their old relationships when they meet with their families in preparation for ultimatum day.

value.title: Ultimatum Day
value.synopsis: After two months of emotional reckoning, the couples must take the leap and decide if their ultimatum ends in wedding bells or a tearful breakup.

value.title: Reunion
value.synopsis: Where are they now? The couples air big feelings, unfinished business and stunning developments during their first sit-down since Ultimatum Day.
